root_cause.text: The UFS core driver failed to flush the exception event handling work (eeh_work) during system suspend when the runtime power management level was UFS_PM_LVL_0 (active power mode and link state), allowing a pending work item to access the host controller after it had entered a deep power-down state, causing a system crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `flush_work(&hba->eeh_work)` inside the condition `if (req_dev_pwr_mode == UFS_ACTIVE_PWR_MODE && req_link_state == UIC_LINK_ACTIVE_STATE)`, and the commit description states: "Previously, the UFS core driver bypassed flushing exception event handling jobs in this configuration. This created a race condition where the driver could attempt to access the host controller to handle an exception after the system had already entered a deep power-down state, resulting in a system crash."
